references.text: God looked with favor on Abel and his offering
The Lord said to Cain: Why are you angry, and why has your face fallen? If you do what is right, you can lift up your face
Moses prayed: Do not turn to their offering – parallel to God not looking at Cain's offering
By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain
We should not be like Cain, who was of the evil one and murdered his brother
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination, especially when he brings it forward with evil intentions
Illuminates the inherent anger and envy of the ungodly when they encounter God's favor toward the righteous.
